title: From seed to sample
alt: A pipeline from seed through generator state and a 16-point grid to the sampling function and output, with an inset showing a boundary at 0.10 between grid points 1/16 and 2/16, giving an actual probability of 0.125.
caption: All the way down: a seed drives a finite grid, and a probability boundary can only fall between grid points.
data_source: Toy generator S_{t+1} = (5 S_t + 1) mod 16, U_t = S_t/16, from the post. Thumbnails reuse the die boundaries (.05, .15, .30, .50, .70) and Box-Muller radii (0.76, 1.18, 1.67), scaled down.
